articles.title: CFTC chair claims Gemini case was politically motivated, seeks to reverse $5M settlement
articles.snippet: The CFTC chair seeks to roll back an enforcement action on the company founded by Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss, donors to Donald Trump’s 2024 campaign and attendees at White House events.

articles.title: Strategy’s Bitcoin sale causes clash for $80M in Polymarket bets
articles.snippet: A clash has erupted among Polymarket users over the timing and disclosure of a recent Bitcoin sale by Strategy, with more than $80 million traded on the disputed outcome.

articles.title: New York’s Crypto Watchdog Teams With EU to Police Stablecoins
articles.snippet: The New York Department of Financial Services and European Banking Authority said they'll work together to oversee stablecoins.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Saylor Sells Bitcoin for First Time Since 2022
articles.snippet: Bitcoin fell below $70K on the back of the sales, and a major Polymarket dispute is brewing over whether Strategy indeed sold in May or not.

articles.title: Strategy's Bitcoin Sale Timing Throws $50 Million Polymarket Bet Into Dispute
articles.snippet: Polymarket users are waiting for a resolution on whether Strategy's Bitcoin sale took place before the end of May—with over $50 million bet so far.
